manifest: QUARANTINE LEDGER — WHAT WAS MOVED, WHY, AND THE PROOF IT WAS SAFE

law.preserve: Nothing is deleted. Every quarantined item is moved intact and remains readable.
law.proof_before_move: Before any move, live references are swept. An item with live callers is NOT moved.
law.report_same_turn: Every move is reported to the operator in the same turn it happens.
law.persona_untouchable: Citizen cards, souls, voice registries and persona prompts are never quarantined, trimmed or redefined. They are read-only law.

entries.what_it_was: A nested second checkout of the main repository (a recursive duplicate of the same tree, including its own .git and barn copy).
entries.purpose: Mirror of the main repo for side-by-side comparison.
entries.why_moved: Recursive duplicate: it doubled the SSOT ambiguity the deep audit was measuring.
entries.proof_of_safety: Reference sweep across the active surface found zero live callers — the only mentions are inside ingested transcript records.

entries.what_it_was: A foreign third-party agent sample (an outside framework's agent template with an evaluation set) sitting in the repository root, carrying another vendor's product names throughout.
entries.purpose: An imported example agent, not part of the collective.
entries.why_moved: The no-outside-naming law: no third-party product names may sit in the active surface. It was the only active-surface file carrying them.
entries.proof_of_safety: Reference sweep found zero live callers — mentioned only inside ingested transcripts.

entries.what_it_was: The canonical blackboard at the moment it was found holding an empty lineage table while its truth sat in the reconcile backups.
entries.purpose: Canonical evidence store — lineage DAG, knowledge objects, blackboard registers.
entries.why_moved: It had to be set aside so the full truth could be consolidated from the backups and rebuilt in place.
entries.proof_of_safety: The canonical file is BACK IN PLACE and live: 3,392 lineage nodes, 25,341 knowledge objects, 2,028 blackboard registers; the displaced copy is preserved alongside.

entries.what_it_was: Working copies and pre-consolidation snapshots taken while the blackboard was rebuilt.
entries.purpose: Rollback material for the consolidation operation.
entries.why_moved: Not a move — a preservation of the pre-change state so the operation could be reversed.

entries.what_it_was: Memory records admitted as ACCEPTED before the Poincaré semantic gate was wired into the write path: signed, Merkle-grounded payloads with false values.
entries.purpose: Canonical state for agent memory reads.
entries.why_moved: They were accepted only because the governor had no semantic gate and its contradiction veto was defeated by row-id collision plus unordered reads. Keeping them ACCEPTED would let every reader treat poison as truth.
entries.proof_of_safety: Byte-identical backup at memory/catch_log/backups/governed_memory_20261115T081220Z.db (sha256 8b062157afb52e4a852e4dc85ad2df4a92e8613e6c849d5380d04179b3698eee); rows copied intact into memory_records_quarantine; originals marked QUARANTINED, not deleted.

entries.item: misc/ text bulk (66,260 files, 2,254,748,427 raw bytes)
entries.what_it_was: Documentation-scrape dump: Gradle doc HTML, npm registry JSON, .emlx mail, js/ts/py source scrapes, plus misc text — untracked, zero live callers (sweep proved only transcript mentions).
entries.purpose: Bulk residue inside the SSOT workspace consuming critical disk.
entries.why_moved: Disk at 96% (539 MB free at the low point); owner directive to offload the unneeded bulk to the GitHub barn rather than shift it locally.
entries.proof_of_safety: Reference sweep found zero live callers; no symlinks point into misc/; every batch pushed as an orphan commit to aoxendine3/xoras-barn-misc and verified remote-sha == local commit sha BEFORE local deletion; per-file sha256 manifests at memory/catch_log/barn_misc_manifests/batch_0001..0012.json.

entries.item: misc/ orphaned Ollama model blobs (6 files, ~2.6 GB)
entries.what_it_was: sha256-named blobs: three referenced by zero Ollama manifests (orphaned from deleted models), three byte-duplicates of live blobs.
entries.why_moved: Provable garbage: orphaned (no manifest references them) or duplicate; owner directive to make room.
entries.proof_of_safety: Every blob's content hash verified to match its filename; ollama manifests grep = 0 references; duplicates matched live ~/.ollama blobs by name and size.
entries.preserved_at: not preserved - hash-verified garbage per owner 'make room' directive; hashes recorded in this entry

entries.reason: Attempted stale-state quarantine as app repair. Live-reference sweep output was misread: app processes (main 10329, helpers 10333/10334, language_server 10363) were running. Per Law 10.5, an item with live callers must NOT be moved.
entries.action: Moved state to scratch/quarantine_antigravity_state_20261118, detected the procedural error at once, preserved the auto-recreated fresh state at scratch/quarantine_antigravity_newstate_20261118, and restored the original state intact to its canonical path. Nothing deleted; both copies readable.
entries.operator_report: Reported in the same turn; original app state verified at 292 MB after restore; app processes still alive.

entries.reason: Stuck Squirrel updater: cached 2.33.0 could not install while app was running (ShipIt log: 'App Still Running Error'); reinstalls kept landing on 2.32.2.
entries.action: Stopped respawning ShipIt launchd job, moved old bundle to scratch/app_upgrade_quarantine_20261118/ intact, updater completed installation of signed 2.33.0; removed FinderInfo xattr; verified codesign + Gatekeeper + live processes. No bytes deleted.

entries.reason: codesign --verify --deep --strict refused the bundle ('detritus not allowed') after the update.
entries.action: Removed only the FinderInfo xattr on the bundle root; signature and notarization re-verified clean.

entries.reason: Continue button did nothing: stale onboarding state recorded persona=engineering and lastLoginIsGcpTos=false with a saved prior login, leaving the flow half-complete.
entries.action: Quit app; backed up app_storage.json to scratch/app_upgrade_quarantine_20261118/app_storage_before_onboarding_reset.json; removed only 4 onboarding keys; validated JSON; relaunched. All other app state untouched.

resolved_not_moved.item: the third world file copy at .sovereign/world_file.db
resolved_not_moved.finding: It was stale — 0 lineage nodes against the canonical 3,392 — yet live instruments name it as their blackboard backend.
resolved_not_moved.action: WIRED, not moved: it is now mirrored from the canonical store, so every instrument reads the same truth. The 14-gate gauntlet still certifies after the change.

resolved_not_moved.finding: A probe showed a bare prompt yields a hollow non-answer while the full persona yields a substantive one.
resolved_not_moved.action: The one temporary trim was REVERTED. Seat, authority, mandate and workspace ship whole. The probe informed the request shape; it did not redefine the persona.
